title: Transfers T4-T6 screens: Manage Payees 'Transfer Payees' group with renaming rules (several per payee), remove 'Treat as transfer' and 'Transfer rules' tab, category menu without Payment/Transfer, popover 'always' writes a renaming rule
description: Plan .agents/plans/2026-11-24_transfers-refactor.md tasks T4, T5, T6 and the owner decisions in it. Owner's reference: YNAB's Manage Payees with a 'Transfer Payees' group, one per account, each with Renaming rules ('Imported payees that match these rules will be renamed'), and the note that transfer payees are created by the app and cannot be edited or deleted. Server is ready on main: GET /payees?include_transfers=true (transfer_account_id, transfer_account_name), payee_id on transaction create/update, rename-rule operations list/add/update/remove, 409 transfer_payee_protected, account_name_exists.
notes:
landed outside tk close at 4a25a9f (branch tk/budget-p8td merged into main by hand)
Merged to local main as 4a25a9f; owner asked to finish and review the screens, then release once (Inbox thread 'Transfers refactor', 2026-11-25). Manage Payees with Transfer Payees and several renaming rules, Apply to past with preview and undo, explicit Convert step for old transfer rules, register and pickers by payee (Category not needed, no Payment/Transfer button, payee_id on writes), popover writes a renaming rule, no outside-the-budget transfer. Three independent reviews attached; engine numbers identical to main on the reviewers' probes. Orchestrator reran on 4bab45f: client 1564 pass, shared 224, tsc and eslint clean; and the full suite on main after the merge.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots at 1400 and 375 of each changed screen from the running app; client tsc, eslint, tests green; a transfer can be made by picking a transfer payee, remembered by a renaming rule, and undone, on web and at phone width.
